correctness.rationale: For independent uniform parent choices, the leaf survival P(Y_v=1)=(v-1)/(n-1), with each new child of i protecting other potential leaves and killing its own leaf status. Sum of the exact individual covariances yields Cov(D_i,L_n)=(n-i)/(2(n-1))-(i-1)(H_{n-2}-H_{i-2})/(n-1), root and terminal edge cases included. Discrete convexity gives one positive-to-negative crossing (first positive i=2 at n=7); harmonic scaling gives unique interior root of (1-alpha)/2+alpha log alpha. Independent complete enumeration of parent-choice trees n=2..7 exactly reproduced formula. Finite enumeration is corroboration, not an all-n proof.
residual_risks: The exact threshold decimal is numerical; uniqueness is analytic. No distributional association or stochastic ordering follows from covariance sign.
